en.bdb: Negation of self conceit is the salvation

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਮੇਲ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh peer mureedh mel milaavahee|

en.bdb: Lacs of spiritualists and their disciples assemble.
Myriads of beggers ave pilgrimages at the martyries.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਰੋਜੇ ਲਖ ਈਦ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਕਰਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh roje lakh ieedh nivaaj karaavahee|

en.bdb: Millions of people observe fasts (roza) and offer namaz (prayer) of id.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਫਤ ਸੁਨੀਦ ਮਨ ਪਰਚਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: kar kar gufat suneedh man parachaavahee|

en.bdb: Many entice their minds by being busy in questioning and answering.
Many are engaged in preparing the key of evotion for opening the lock of mind's temple.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਰਸੀਦ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਵਹੀ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: dhar dharaves raseedh na aap janaavahee ||13||

en.bdb: But those Who by becoming dervish at the door of Lord have become acceptable, never show their individuality.
